title: Cuentos de Camerino flamenco show
text: A compelling evening of flamenco presented by a young collective of very talented performers. The theatrical approach used the location in the Vieja Fábrica de Sombreros to great effect, candlelit and very atmospheric. We are in Seville for the month, seeing performances almost nightly, mainly at peñas and bars, but this one was quite unique and comes highly recommended.
author: dfkelly99
